g.text: 4-1. Message arrives while the session is IDLE - webhook side
WebhookParser.parse - checks the signature, then parses the events
signature does not match, or no X-Line-Signature header
one body can hold several events - handle_webhook
runs them one after another, in the order of the list
keeps line_message_id so the worker can download it
any other type (location, sticker, audio, ...) -> None
on_message returns - nothing saved, no reply
INSERT sessions - an open session already exists: returns that one
INSERT messages, role user, status pending
the same webhookEventId a second time -> insert_message raises
UniqueViolationError -> 500, no second row, nothing added to Redis
no key (IDLE) -> set succeeds -> state = BUFFERING
True -> on_message queues the chat job
the webhook does not reply - the worker does (4-2)
